script: Fidji Simo left OpenAI's safety team.

A medical issue forced her exit.
Safety now has a leadership void.

instagram.caption:
🛑 The person who could hit pause on a dangerous OpenAI launch just stepped down.  

Fidji Simo left her AGI safety role due to a non-critical illness. She led the team focused on preventing harm, not rushing out models.  

Now there’s no one inside with the same authority to delay a release over safety concerns.  

If you use text or images from an OpenAI tool in your work, your next update could land without that internal brake.  

Who gets the safety chief seat—and will they have real power to say no?
